tei:div.tei:p: (1na)chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag thog babs dang mgur 'bum rnams bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag thog babs dang*/ yang thog tu gyur ba 'di la don gnyis te/ phyogs snga ma log par rtog pa lnga bsal ba dang*/ gdams ngag dngos so// dang po phyogs snga ma log rtog bsal ba lnga'i dang po/ ngo bo la log rtog bsal ba ni/ da lta'i sems ngan pa spangs nas/ phyis ye shes bzang po 'dod pa yin la/ gdams ngag 'di yi lugs kyis chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems yin te/ de la gang yang spang du med pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa yul la log pa bsal ba ni/ dug lnga spang bar 'dod pa de/ gdams ngag 'di yi lugs kyis/ lam du 'khyer ba'o// gsum pa dus la log par rtog pa bsal ba ni/ bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis rtogs par 'dod pa de/ gdams ngag 'di'i lugs kyis da lta rang rtogs par 'dod pa'o// bzhi pa shes rab la log par rtog pa bsal ba ni/ rig pas rtogs par 'dod pa de/ gdams ngag (2na)'di yi lugs kyis gdams ngag gis rtogs par 'dod pa'o// lnga pa sangs rgyas dang sems can la bzang ngan du byed pa'i log par rtog pa bsal ba ni/ rang gis sems rtogs ma rtogs las khyad par gzhan med pa'o// gdams ngag la gsum ste/ dang po sgom mgo rtsom pa la mkhas pa/ bar du nyams brten pa la mkhas pa/ tha ma 'phro gcod pa la mkhas pa'o// dang po sgom mgo rtsom pa la mkhas pa la gnyis/ lus kyi bzhag thabs dang sems kyi bzhag thabs so// dang po lus kyi bzhag thabs ni/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi chos bdun dang ldan pa'o// gnyis pa sems kyi bzhag thabs la gnyis/ sems ma 'khrul ba la ngos bzung ba dang*/ sems 'khrul ba la ngos bzung ba'o// dang po sems ma 'khrul ba la ngos bzung ba ni/ sems kyi ngo bo/ bde gsal mi rtog pa de ma bcos par/ rang lugs rtsol sgrub dang bral bar thog babs su bzhag go /gnyis pa sems 'khrul pa la ngos bzung ba la bzhi/ blta ba'i yul dang*/

lta (2ba)thabs dang*/ mthong tshad dang*/ mthong lugs so// dang po blta yul ni/ dge ba dang*/ mi dge ba dang*/ lung du ma bstan pa'i rnam par rtog pa'o// gnyis pa lta thabs ni/ rnam par rtog pa gang byung la/ shes rab kyi mig gis thog babs su blta ba'o// gsum pa mthong tshad ni/ rnam par rtog pa bud pa'i shul na sems med pa ma yin te/ sems ngo bo stong pa/ sing nge ye re ba cig 'dug pa de/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'o// bzhi pa mthong lugs la bzhi/ ci mthong ba/ dus nam mthong ba/ chos dang ldan par mthong ba/ ji ltar mthong ba'o// ci mthong na/ sems mthong ste/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas so// dus nam mthong na/ thog ma med pa nas yod par ro// chos ci dang ldan par mthong na/ chos thams cad la khyab par mthong ngo*// ji ltar mthong na/ dbang po drug gi spyod yul las 'das par mthong ste/ kha dog dang dbyibs su ma grub pa'o// bar du nyams brten pa la mkhas pa ni/ rgod na de rang gi thog tu gtang*/ bying na rgod du bcug pa de la blta'o// tha mar 'phro gcod pa la mkhas pa ni/ gsal la yun thung bar bya ste/ sgom dang ma 'khon par bzang gyes bya'o// phyag rgya chen po thog babs rtsis kyis rgya mdud dang bcas pa/ rin po che sgam po pa'i man ngag dwags po sgom chung gi phyag dpe/ slob dpon stod lung pa la gdams pa'o/// /bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// 'o cag rnams kyis mi lus rin po che thob nas/ rang nyid blo bde ba'i chos cig ma grub na/ dper na/ sman bcud tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa'i yon tan la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab skad/ len bum pa gang pho nas/ myur du gsod pa'i dug gi (3na)bum pa la 'thung ba de nas ngan song gsum du 'khyams/ lta bu yin gsungs/ dam pa sangs rgyas mjal bar dka' ba'i bla ma dang mjal ba don yod par bya dgos/ dang mjal/ zhal gyi bdud rtsi thob nas/ tshe

thob par dka' ba'i gdams ngag khyad par can nyon mongs pa'i dug ni zhi bar byed pas 'khor ba mtha' dag las blo ldog dgos/ 'di la blo ma log /da res don cig ma grub na/ ru tra'am srin po dang khyad med pa yin/ theg chen gyi chos la longs spyod/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis la blo sbyang du yod pa'i dus 'dir/ grub pa zhig ma thob na/ mi nag tha mal ba dang khyad med de/ shin tu glen pa nags dang chu'i mig dang 'dra skad/ phag lta bu yin/ sems la nges shes skyes nas/ zas 'dod yon la blo ldog ma nus na/ yi dwags kyi zas skom ma myong pas gdungs pa dang khyad med do// rgyud la 'od gsal shar/ sgom bzang zer nas/ tshe 'di la zhen cing dug lnga spong ma nus na/ sgom bzang yang go yul du song ba yin te/ kha chos kyis mi phan chos gnad du phog dgos/ 'khor ba las mi thar/ smyon pa'i nang nas yang smyon pa bya ba yin/ de ni skyes bu tha shal phyi ba lta bu yin no// dug lnga'am/ dug gsum po 'dis ni/ dus rtag tu 'o skol mgo bskor ba yin te/ 'o cag gis mi tshor bas/ da ni 'bungs la mgo ma nyon mongs pa ngo shes dgos/ de'i gnyen por bla ma'i gdams ngag rnams go dgos/ 'khor ba zhig bya dgos/ sgom rkyen thog tu mi khel ba'i/ bzang ba dang*/ shes rab che bas chos ma go ba dang*/ btsun pa bar sgoms kyang las 'bras la mi 'dzem par/ dang*/ brtson 'grus che ba la sogs pa/ tshe 'di'i bya ba la brtson/ khas len bzang po'i dgos don da res 'di nas las 'bras la 'dzem pa dang dge mi dge'i sa mtshams shan phyed dgos/ yod pas gzab pa yang gal che ste/ skyes tsam la gzobs shig bya ba bla ma sangs rgyas gsung*/ (3ba)yid la bya dgos/ lar nang du chos cig la so thebs na/ phyi nang gi nang rtags nang nyon mongs pa'i dug zhi ba/ phyi rtag chags sdang chung ba dang*/ rgyud 'jam zhing mnyen par 'gyur ro// rtags bag re yang 'ong dgos/

thug 'dom byung ba'i dus su rang gi rgyud la lhod bag tsam re yang dgos par 'dug /rkyen ma byung tsa na/ thams cad bzang ba mchi bar gda' bas/ da chos kyis phan nam/ mi phan rang la lta dgos lags/ rang gis rang la zhal ta snying thag pa nas byed dgos pa lags/ gros rang la 'debs dgos pa lags/ mi la gros 'debs pa kha na ba las med do// bla mas gsungs pa de mad par mchis so// zhal gyi gdams pa'o/// /na mo gu ru/ tshe gcig po 'di nyid la sangs rgya bar byed pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag ni/ don gnyis las med do// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku dang*/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od do// snang ba 'di sems nyid kyi 'od yin te/ dper na/ nyi ma dang*/ nyi ma'i 'od lta bu'o// don sems nyid las med/ sems nyid gtan la 'bebs pa la/ snang ba 'di gtan la 'bebs dgos te/ snang ba 'di/ med par shes par bya ba dang*/ snang ba 'di/ med bzhin du snang ba shes pa'i cho 'phrul du go ba dang*/ dang po nyams su myong ba smrar mi btub pa'o// dang po ni/ snang ba 'di yod pa yin nam/ med pa yin zer na/ med pa yin/ med par snang ba 'gal zer na/ de bas ni/ 'khrul pa yin/ ngo mtshar che/ 'o na 'di rgyu ci las byung zer na/ sems nyid kyi cho 'phrul yin no// des snang ba rang bzhin med pa sgom du ma bcos pa'o// sems nyid sgoms shig /de tsam na/ nyams khong nas shar tsam na/ sgro 'dogs phyi nas chod de 'ong*/ (4na)dper na/ rab rib bam/ mig gi ling thog bzhin no// nyams su myong ba smrar mi btub pa ni/ lkugs pas bu ram mur ba bzhin no// de ltar sems nyid gtan la phebs tsa na/ nyams su len pa'i thabs ni gsum ste/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ngang la bzhag thabs ni/ lus sems khong glod la/ dran med 'bras med du glod la bzhag go /yang*/ bla ma dam pa'i lung la yid ches par byas la/ rig pa sna ma bskyil bar tshogs drug lhug par bzhag go

/cir snang thams cad rnam rtog tu shes par bya'o// rnam rtog chos sku shes par bya'o// de ltar nyams su blangs pas nyams kyi rtogs pa 'char te/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor dang*/ spros bral gyi rnal 'byor dang*/ du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor dang*/ bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor rnams rgyud la skye ba yin no// skye lugs ni/ gang zag gi sbyangs pa che chung gis/ rim gyis skye ba dang*/ thod rgal du skye ba dang*/ cig car du skye ba ni nges pa med do// de tsa na/ chos sku mngon du byas nas/ smon lam gyi stobs kyis gzugs sku gnyis 'char ba ni/ sangs rgyas pa yin no// snyi sgom dwags po rin po che'i gsung sgros/ dwags po sgom chung la gdams pa/ des slob dpon stod lung pa la/ des tshul khrims ye shes la gdams pa'o/// /na mo gu ru/ bla ma rin po che'i mahā mu drā'i gegs sel ni/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba ni stong pa nyid la bya'o// stong pa nyid ni gnyis te/ bcos ma'i stong pa nyid dang*/ rang bzhin gyi stong pa nyid do/ de la rang bzhin gyi stong pa nyid kyis sangs rgya bar 'gyur gyis/ bcos ma'i stong pa nyid kyis ni ma yin no// tshig tu brjod cing*/ blo yi yul du byas (4ba)pas don gyi thog tu phebs par 'dod pa de byas pa'i stong nyid yin pas/ byas pa'i chos kyis sangs rgya ba mi srid do// mtshan ma'i chos yin pa'i phyir ro// des na/ stong pa nyid la blta nyes na// shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ stong nyid kyi 'phrang ni/ stong nyid shes bya'i gshis su shor ba/ stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba/ stong nyid nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por shor ba/ stong nyid lam du shor ba'o// gol sa bzhi ni/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched du gol ba/ yod min med min gyi skye mched du gol ba/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched du gol ba/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched du gol ba dang bzhi'o// der gol na nyes pa che ste/

de yang*/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa ri'i rgyal po ri rab tsam du 'dzin kyang bla'o// stong pa nyid la blta nyes pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gsor mi rung ste/ lta ba drug cu rtsa gnyis gzhi can no// zhes gsungs so// des na/ rang bzhin gyi stong pa nyid bsgom par bya ste/ rang bzhin gyi stong pa nyid ni/ phug gang yang ma thug /rgya gar yang ma chad/ dpe gang gis kyang mtshon du med/ don gang gis kyang thog tu mi phebs/ de ltar na/ tshig gis ces kyang brjod du mi btub ste/ smras pa kun ni rdzun po yin/ des na/ phyag rgya chen po la lta ba med/ lta ba byung na phyogs ris yin/ des na/ sems kyi 'khris thag rbad kyis bcad pa'i ngang la/ so ma/ rang thang*/ lhug pa gsum la bzhag go /bla ma rin po che'i phyag dpe/ khu dbon gnyis ka'i gsung sgros/ slob dpon stod lung pa la gdams pa/ gegs sel gyi man ngag go// /na mo gu ru/ phyag rgya bzhi'i gdams ngag (5na)la/ las kyi phyag rgya dpe/ chos kyi phyag rgya las/ phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya gzhan don no// dang po las kyi phyag rgya la gnyis/ dpe'i lhan cig skyes pa dang*/ don gyi lhan cig skyes pa'o// dang po dpe'i lhan cig skyes pa ni/ bum nang gi mar me lta bu 'od phyir 'don ma nus pa/ zag bcas kyi bde ba la dngos por 'dzin pa de la bya'o// gnyis pa don gyi lhan cig skyes pa ni/ zag med kyi bde ba la ngos 'dzin par byed pas/ bde ba la ma chags/ ma zhen ba/ de'i don rang bzhin med par shes pa/ bde gsal rtog med tsam la 'jog shes pa'o// lar chos kyi phyag rgya la gnyis/ gnyug ma dang bcas pa dang*/ gnyug ma dang bral ba'o// dang po gnyug ma dang bcas pa ni/ spyod lam bzhi la rgyun mi 'chad pa chu bo gaṅgā lta bu/ don dang ldan pa/ don la mi 'gyur pa/ de'i don la spyod pa la ngos bzung med pa/

mnyam rjes la khyad med pa'o// gnyis pa gnyug ma dang bral ba ni/ ye shes dum pa bsgoms na 'ong*/ ma bsgoms na mi 'ong bas/ las stobs su ma gyur pa'o// 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po la gnyis/ dri ma dang bcas pa dang*/ dri ma dang bral ba'o// dang po dri ma dang bcas pa ni/ don la de tsug tu shes kyang*/ rgyud la nyams myong du ma skyes pa/ dngos po'i re dwogs kyi thag pa ma chod pa de la bya/ gnyis pa dri ma dang bral ba ni/ nam mkha' sprin med pa la nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ re dwogs med/ rtsis gdab med pa/ tshig dang bral ba/ 'di la cir yang byar med pa/ de ka la 'bras bu mthar phyin pa zhes bya'o/// /dam tshig gi phyag rgya gzhan don gtso bor byed pa la gnyis rgyud dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang*/ 'bras bu dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o// dang po rgyud dam tshig (5ba)gi phyag rgya ni/ rang don mthar phyin pa'o// gnyis pa 'bras bu dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni/ byams snying rje gzhan don mthar phyin pa'o// phyag rgya bzhi'i gdams pa/ bla ma rin po che'i phyag dpe/ dwags po sgom chung la gdams pa'o/// /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nas pha ma'i rgyu rkyen shar// nang nas kun gzhi'i rnam shes shar// bar du mi lus gtsang ma thob// ngan song gsum du ma skyes tsam// skye shi'i sdug bsngal phyi nas shar// zhen log 'dod pa nang nas shar// bar du dam pa'i lha chos dran// gnyen dang dgra la ma chags tsam// bla ma'i gdams ngag phyi nas shar// dpyod byed kyi rig pa nang nas shar// bar du yid ches shes rab skyes// thos pa la the tshom mi za tsam// snang ba sna tshogs phyi nas shar// bde stong nyams myong nang nas shar// bar du 'dzin med rig pa gsal// 'khrul snang rkyen phyir ma 'brangs tsam// khams gsum rang grol phyi nas shar// ye shes rang byung nang nas shar// bar du rtogs pa'i gdeng dang ldan// don la nyam nga mi skye tsam// 'dod yon rnam lnga phyi nas shar// rjes med shes rab nang nas shar// bar du ro snyoms spyod pa byas// skyid sdug gnyis su mi 'dzin tsam// byas chos 'jig pa phyi nas shar// re dogs med pa nang nas shar// bar du rtsol sgrub nad dang bral// dge sdig chos la ma ltas tsam// khams gsum sems can phyi nas shar// snying rje phyogs med nang nas shar// bar du gdams ngag nyams su myong*// snying rje zhe 'dod du ma shor tsam// lta ba kha rtogs gting ma rtogs// dge sbyor gcog pa'i 'dre cig gda'// sgom pa yid smon lteng po de// slob gnyer gcog pa'i 'dre cig gda'// spyod pa tshul 'chos tho co (6na)can// gzhan sdig gsog pa'i 'dre cig gda'// 'bras bu nyon mongs kha ma bri// sems 'khor bar 'khrid pa'i 'dre cig gda'// lar gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs kyang*// dkar po'i chos rnams mi gcog 'tshal// sgom du med pa'i don rtogs kyang*// thabs kyi zhabs tog mi gcog 'tshal// spyod pa blang dor ma mchis kyang*// gzhan gyi sdig rkyen mi bgyid 'tshal// 'bras bu re dwogs ma mchis kyang*// sems nyon mongs kha yan du mi btang 'tshal// gdams ngag lpags la yab bsus 'dra// bla ma mkhas la zhus lags sam// nyams myong mun par zla shar 'dra// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsgoms lags sam// rtogs pa nam mkha' stong pa 'dra// gnyug ma'i yid kyis bzung lags sam// 'chi khar mi 'gyod gcig kyang med// rang sems dpang por tshugs lags sam// lta ba gnyis med nam mkha' la// rtag chad du ma lta rnal 'byor kun// sgom pa rang gsal 'grib med la// bying rgod du ma lta rnal 'byor kun// spyod pa rang grol shugs 'byung la// blang dor du ma lta rnal 'byor kun// 'bras bu ye sangs rgyas pa la// re dwogs su ma lta rnal 'byor kun/// /na mo gu ru/

dang po sgro 'dogs chod lags kyang*// da rung skabs su the tshom byung*// lta bas kyang rnal 'byor slu slu 'dra// spros bral gyi sems dang mi 'bral 'tshal// dang po yang skye med rtogs lags kyang*// da rung skabs su rnam rtog byung*// sgom pas kyang rnal 'byor slu slu 'dra// yengs med kyi sems dang mi 'bral 'tshal// dang po yang 'dzin med la gnas nas kyang*// da rung skabs su 'dzin chags byung*// spyod pas kyang rnal 'byor slu slu 'dra// zhen med kyi sems (6ba)dang mi 'bral 'tshal// dang po yang the tshom chod nas kyang*// da rung skabs su zhe 'dod byung*// 'bras bus kyang rnal 'byor slu slu 'dra// lhun grub kyi sems dang mi 'bral 'tshal// dang po yang thod rgal bgyis nas kyang*// da rung skabs su nyam nga byung*// chos brgyad kyi rnal 'byor slu slu 'dra// gnyen po'i sems dang mi 'bral 'tshal// dang po yang dgra gnyen spangs nas kyang*// da rung skabs su ngo srung byung*// mthun 'jug gi rnal 'byor slu slu 'dra// da yang ngo bsrung mi bgyid 'tshal// dang po yang dad pa skyes nas kyang*// da rung skabs su btang snyoms byung*// le los kyang rnal 'byor slu slu 'dra// brtson 'grus kyi sems dang mi 'bral 'tshal// pha cig bla ma rje btsun la// dad gus rgyun chad mi bgyid 'tshal// lha cig dkon mchog gsum po la// mchod pa rgyun chad mi bgyid 'tshal// 'khor ba'i sems can ma rgan la// snying rje rgyun chad mi bgyid 'tshal// gdams ngag thugs kyi nying khu la// tshig gi lhad dang mi bsre 'tshal// rang sems 'od gsal stong pa la// glo bur rnam rtog gis mi bslad 'tshal// 'jig gis dogs nas mkhar zhig rtsig /mkhar ni chos nyid stong pa'i mkhar// da ni 'jig snyam mi bgyid do// 'khyags kyis dogs nas gos cig btsal// gos ni gnyug ma lhun grub gos// da yang 'khyags snyam mi bgyid do// skyo yis dogs nas grogs cig btsal// grogs ni bde stong rgyun pa'i grogs// da yang skyo snyam mi bgyid do// nor gyis dogs nas lam cig btsal// lam ni zung 'jug yangs pa'i lam// da yang nor snyam mi bgyid do// sems nyid 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// yod dang med dang gnyis ka min// rnam rtog blo yi yul las (7na)'das// lta ba mdzad na de la mdzod// nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba bzhin// rang sems gsal la ma 'gags pa'i// nyams myong rgyun chad med pa de// sgom pa mdzad na de la mdzod// 'gro 'chags nyal 'dug thams cad du// yengs pa med cing 'dzin pa med// mi bcos lhun gyis grub pa yi// spyod pa mdzad na de la mdzod// lar lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum// tha dad 'dzin na rnam rtog yin// rnam rtog sems nyid ngang du zhi// rnam rtog zhi na bde ba mchog

/sgom chen man ngag med pa de// shul ring 'gron pos lam stor 'dra// sgom chen zhen pa ma spangs pa// bya chen thang la 'khor ba 'dra// sgom chen nyams myong ma brtan pa// chu phran than pas bskams pa 'dra// sgom chen thos pa chung ba ste// bong sprug rtod la mnan pa 'dra// sgom chen spyod lam nyes pa de// byis pa gces sprug bslab nyes 'dra// sgom chen 'tsho ba ma 'byongs pa// khyi rgan grong rgyun byed pa 'dra// sems stong pa'i nang na rig pa 'phyo// gzung 'dzin bya ba'i ming yang med// lta ba'i thag chod blo re bde// chos nyid nang na sems nyid 'phyo// bying rgod bya ba'i ming yang med// sgom pa'i thag chod blo re bde// 'gag med nang na shugs 'byung 'phyo// blang dor bya ba'i ming yang med// spyod pa'i thag chod blo re bde// chos sku'i nang na gzugs sku 'phyo// re dwogs bya ba'i ming yang med// 'bras bu'i thag chod blo re bde// lta ba'i dus su phyogs ris byung*// phyal gyis btang la mi btang ri// sgom pa'i dus su bying rgod byung*// sems la bltas la mi btang ri// spyod pa'i dus su tshul 'chos byung*// gcer bur rgyugs la mi btang ri// stong nyid phyar po lta ba'i bdud// yod pa bkag pa'i (7ba)med pa la// spros bral zhes ni mi brjod do// chad pa'i phyogs su 'gro nyen gda'o// mi rtog lteng po sgom pa'i bdud// nges shes gting nas ma skyes par// nyams myong bzang ngan mi brjod do// gti mug phyogs su 'gro nyen gda'o// tshul 'chos the tshom spyod pa'i bdud// glo bur zhe 'dod ma khegs par// shugs 'byung yin zhes mi brjod do// bcos ma'i phyogs su 'gro nyen gda'o// sems can mi 'di 'khrul tshabs che// mi skya 'khrul pa ye 'khrul yin// sdig can 'khrul pa yang 'khrul yin// chos pa 'khrul pa a re phangs// skye med nyams su mi len par// ched du sgyu ma'i nor tshol 'khrul// gcig pur nyams myong mi skyong bar// mang po'i dpon po byed pa 'khrul// dman pa'i spyod pa mi skyong bar// che bcos 'dir ka byas te 'khrul// gcig chog gi gdams ngag mi skyong bar// tha snyad kyi tshig rjes 'brangs te 'khrul// phyogs med kyi bde sar mi sdod par// zhen pas pha yul bzung ba 'khrul// shes pa 'brel med mi sgom par// mi chos kyi rnam bzhag bzung ste 'khrul// rang lus dgon par mi shes par// phug stong gza' med bzung ste 'khrul// chos kyang rang la mi bshad par// zhal ta mi la byas te 'khrul// rang gi skyon la mi lta bar// gang zag gzhan la gshe ste 'khrul// brjod med kyi don la mi lta bar// tshe 'di rtag par bzung ste 'khrul/// /na mo gu ru/

gnas chos 'byung gru gsum gzhal yas khang*// rje sprul pa'i sku yi zhabs kyis bcags// ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs// dom tshang shel gyi brag phug 'dir// bdag spro ba skyes pas dbyangs cig len// bka' brgyud nor bu rin po che// sgro skur gnyis kyis (8na)ma bslad par// nā ro mai trī'i brgyud pa thob// gsol ba 'debs pa 'di dang re spro// sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur bas// byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun ma chad pa// yongs su grags pa'i sgam po pa// rje spyi gtsug gi rgyan du dang re spro// chos nyid blo yis ma reg par// spros bral nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// lhan cig skyes pa bdud rtsi'i ro// chos phyag rgya chen po 'di dang re spro// rgyud sde bzhi yi bcud phyung nas// snyan brgyud tshig gis ma bslad par// ngo sprod ma bu phrad pa 'dra// thabs lam zab mo 'di dang re spro// dam tshig g.yo sgyus ma bslad par// shel ltar dag pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bya ra gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gros byed// yun bar chad mi 'byung dang re spro/// /na mo gu ru/ rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa de// stong nyid zer yang chad lta yin// dngos po'i 'dzin pa ma grol na// rtogs ldan zer yang rtag lta yin// stong pa snying rje dbyer med 'di// rtag chad gnyis dang bral ba yin// 'di ni lta ba'i 'khyer so yin// gdod nas dag pa'i chos nyid la// sems kyi glang po yan du chug /rtog pa chos sku'i ngang du 'khyer// 'di ni sgom pa'i 'khyer so yin// thams cad sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la// shugs 'byung gi spyod pa mi 'gag ste// zhe 'dod kyi tshul 'chos bor nas btang*// 'di ni spyod pa'i 'khyer so yin// sems rtogs pa las chos sku 'byung*// ro bde bar shar bas longs sku 'byung*// gsal ba'i ngang las sprul sku 'char// 'di ni 'bras bu'i 'khyer so yin/// /na mo gu ru/

dug lnga khong du ma bsad na// sdang ba'i dgra la thul dus med// chos mnyam pa nyid du go lags pas// zhe sdang med pa'i mi re bde// 'brel (8ba)med cig khong nas ma shar na// sha khrag gi gnyen la mgu dus med// chags sdang sdug bsngal gyi rgyur rtogs pas// gdung sems med pa'i mi re bde// zas nor sgyu mar ma shes na// stong pa'i sems la gang dus med// sred pas tshwa chu 'thung ba 'dra// zhen pa log pa'i mi re bde// 'od gsal nang nas ma shar na// ma rig mun pa sangs dus med// gdams ngag zab mos mtshams sbyar nas// sems skye med rtogs pa'i mi re bde// ri khrod 'grim pa'i ldom bu pas// phyi gzung ba'i yul la phar bltas pas// 'jig rten gyi snang ba hrul por thal// 'dus byas kyi dngos po'i zhen pa log /nang 'dzin pa'i sems la tshur bltas pas// sems 'od gsal stong pa chos kyi sku// rtogs ma rtogs gnyis kyi mtshan ma bral// sangs rgyas 'dod pa'i zhen pa log /bar sgyu ma'i lus la tshur bltas pas// lus ni yi dam lha yi sku// nga bdag gnyis kyi mtshan ma bral// lus phung por 'dzin pa'i zhen pa log// /na mo gu ru/ 'jig rten bya ba kun spangs nas// bla ma'i gdams ngag nyams blangs pas// rtsol ba dmigs su phog nas ni// gtum mo'i drod ni me ltar 'bar// sgyu ma'i lus ni yang zhing bde// dbugs ni 'byung 'jug med par stong*// sgom pa bying rgod med par gsal// sems ni nga bdag ngos bzung med// gang la'ang ma ltos nam mkha' 'dra// bsam dang brjod dang stong nyid klong*// rang rig rang gsal bde 'jam 'dra// sngar ma skyes pa'i da mi 'gag /dus gsum rgyun du gnyug mar gnas// 'phel 'grib med par dngos grub 'byung*// de don 'gyur med ma bsgoms na// sdug bsngal rnams dang mi 'bral zhing*// 'khor ba'i 'dam nas mi thar (9na)bas// nyin dang mtshan du rgyun du bsgoms// don gyi ting 'dzin brtan gyur nas// ye shes kyi grogs su gyur pa na// thad kar bsam pa'i chos rnams la// gnyen po spangs gnyen med par spyad// bdag gi nyams myong rtogs tshad 'di// bla ma rje la rtogs par 'bul/// /na mo gu ru/

'khrul pa rtsad nas chod lags pas// ma rig 'khrul pa brjed de thal// sku gsum 'bral med kyi don rtogs pas// go lo'i shes pa brjed de thal// snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag sems sems nas// yig nag gi zin bris brjed de thal// rang sems gtan la 'bebs 'bebs nas// rgyud 'grel gyi tha snyad brjed de thal// zhen med cig nyams su len len nas// log 'tsho'i longs spyod brjed de thal// sgyu lus la dgon pa byed byed nas// bde 'tshams kyi dgon pa brjed de thal// dmigs su med par 'khyams 'khyams nas// gnas ther zug tu sdod pa brjed de thal// gcig pur nyams su len len nas// mang po'i ngo bsrung brjed de thal// 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum// mnyam pa nyid du bsgoms bsgoms nas// 'chi bas 'jigs pa brjed de thal/// /na mo gu ru/ sgyu lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la// 'dod yon zhen med du byin brlabs nas// nyin dang mtshan du mchod pa 'bul// mchod rdzas med de nga mi 'gyod// phyi snod rang 'khrungs gzhal yas khang*// nang bcud 'gro drug snying po can// shes rab chen pos rtogs bgyid pas// gang na 'dug kyang gzhal yas khang*// su dang phrad kyang yi dam lha// thang sku med de nga mi 'gyod// dkar dmar sna tshogs shog gu la// shes rab chen po'i snag tsha sbyar// dbang po lnga yi yi ge bris// cir snang (9ba)chos kyi dpe ru go /dpe cha med de nga mi 'gyod// lar 'gyod med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// de nyid yod de rtogs pa med// gdams ngag zab mo mtshams sbyar nas// sku gsum 'bral med kyi ting 'dzin shar// mi la ras pa dgyes pa yin/// /na mo gu ru/ rnam rtog 'di spangs pas mi spong ste// rtog med 'di sgrub tu mi btub snyam// snyems bral de sems kyi ngo bor 'dod// yod na bla ma rje btsun mchod// med na shes pa glod la nyol// 'dzam gling grags pa de skad gsung*// lta ba 'gyur med rang grol yin// gnyis 'dzin bgyi yang mi 'tshal lo// sgom pa zhen med bde gsal yin// thun du bcad kyang mi 'tshal lo// spyod pa rang byung lhug pa yin// tshul 'chos bgyi yang mi 'tshal lo// 'bras bu dus gsum mnyam nyid yin// re dwogs bgyi yang mi 'tshal lo/// /pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ma dang mkha' 'gros bar chad sol// mthun pa'i lam sna gyen la drongs// rig pa bde gsal chos kyi dbyings// rgyun chad med par 'od gsal ba// gzhan don grub na byed pa yin// 'khor 'das gnyis med zung 'jug yin// gsol ba 'debs na shes pa yin// nga la bzla rgyu de las med// a yi nag po 'dzum med pa// rlung sems gnyis med zung 'jug yin// 'gro yang phyag rgya chen po yin// 'dug kyang phyag rgya chen po yin// gnyis med phyag rgya chen po yin// rin po ches gsungs pa'o/// /

chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ bka' drin bcu gcig gi mgur bzhugs so// na mo rat+na gu ru/ sngon bsod nams dpag med bsags lags pas// da lta dal 'byor mi lus thob// rin chen (10na)gling du phyin pa 'dra// bla ma'i bka' drin dang po yin// rje sangs rgyas dngos kyis rjes su bzung*// lung bstan rje yi gang ba thob// yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa 'dra// bla ma'i bka' drin gnyis pa yin// kun rdzob rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di// rang bzhin med pa'i snang bar rtogs// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan 'dra// bla ma'i bka' drin gsum pa yi// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// spros dang bral ba'i chos skur rtogs// sprin dang bral ba'i nam mkha' 'dra// bla ma'i bka' drin bzhi pa yin// bla ma phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*// rang sems ngo bo gcig tu 'dres// dbyer med chu la chu bzhag 'dra// bla ma'i bka' drin lnga pa yin// mdo rgyud 'phags pa'i chos rnams la// shes rab snang ba nang nas shar// mun par sgron me bteg pa 'dra// bla ma'i bka' drin drug pa yin// ci bsam lhun gyis grub pa de// dgos 'dod rang gi sems las byung*// rgyal po'i dkor mdzod phye ba 'dra// bla ma'i bka' drin bdun pa yin// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das la sogs// gnyis 'dzin rtog pa rang sar grol// chab rom chu ru zhu ba 'dra// bla ma'i bka' drin brgyad pa yin// gdul bya bsam mi khyab pa la// 'dul byed sprul pa bsam mi khyab// khyab pa chu zla bzhin du brten// bla ma'i bka' drin dgu pa yin// ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar// phyogs bcur chos kyi rnga bo che// 'jigs med seng ge'i sgra bzhin sgrogs// bla ma'i bka' drin bcu pa yin// 'chi 'pho skye ba la sogs pa// lar gyi rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab// sna tshogs sgyu ma bzhin du brten// bla ma'i bka' drin bcu gcig yin// stong gsum yungs 'brur shong ba dang*// rnal 'byor smyon glu len (10ba)pa gnyis// rnal 'byor 'ga' tsam ma lags pa// gzhan gyis thos na brdzun du che// zhes gsungs so/// /

chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gdeng tshad kyi mgur ma bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos grub rtsa ba bla ma rje// sprul sku mchog gi bla ma la// mos gus rgyun chad yod ma myong*// der yang mi 'gyod tsam zhig byung*// pha da rung byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lam sna 'dren gyi yi dam lha// snang stong zhen med lha sku la// sgyu ma'i yid dang bral ma myong*// de yang mi 'gyod tsam zhig byung*// rgyu 'bras dbyer med lam 'khyer ba'i// spyod pa shugs 'byung 'gag med la// chos nyid kyi nyams dang 'bral ma myong*// de yang mi 'gyod tsam zhig byung*// 'khor 'das dbyer med ngo bo gcig /rang sems dri med 'od gsal la// gcer mthong nyams dang 'bral ma myong*// de yang mi 'gyod tsam zhig byung*// tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa yi// yod na bla ma rje btsun mchod// med na lus sems glod la nyal// de yang mi 'gyod tsam zhig byung*// pha da rung byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gdeng tshad kyi mgur/ rje rin po ches gsungs pa/// /na mo gu ru/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las byung ba yin/ mi dge mtha' dag spang*/ dge ba mtha' dag sgrub/ de ni bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa yin/ bla na med pa'i byang chub ma thob bar du de dang mi 'bral bar bgyi'o// bla ma dam pa'i gsung thos nas// tshe 'di blo yis btang nas kyang*// 'jig rten chos brgyad rgyab tu bor// chags zhen med pa'i sgom chen bde// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa 'di// skye ba med pa chos kyi sku// gsal la ma 'gag nyams su long*// sna tshogs snang ba'i mtshan nyid de// de yang bag (11na)chags gzugs brnyan lags// 'od gsal zung 'jug rtogs pa yis// dran med kyi lta bas ma bslus tsam// zhen med kyi bde stong nyams su 'char// rtog med lteng pos ma bslus tsam// yod med gnyis las 'das pa ste// yin min tshig las 'das pa bde// brtags dpyad yul dang bral ba bde// blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid de// rang la shar ba ngo mtshar che/// /phyogs su byed pa'i lta ba dang*// zhen pa dang ma bral sgom pa dang*// gnyis su 'dzin pa'i spyod pa gsum// khong 'jig rten pa yi lta ba lags// rang sems rtogs nas de bas gzhan med go ba'i sgom chen pa de skyid// bsgom rgyu med par rang sems rnal mar bzhag pas chog par go ba'i sgrub pa po de skyid// ngo bo rnal mar shar bas nges shes skyes// skye 'jig gnyis dang bral bar go ba skyid// rang sems skye ba med pa lta bar go
/skye med don la rtse gcig sgom par go /de las yengs pa med pa spyod par go /rang sems rtogs pa gcig pus chog /tshig la ma blta don la ltos/// /
